title: Meeting Time Spread
description: Stops a recurring meeting always landing in the same person's night by setting the start on a slider with every attendee's own day underneath (night, before work, working, after work, weekend, a day ahead or behind, and DST weeks when the gap shifts, from the tz database), and suggesting the kindest slot: nobody at night first, then the fewest people out of hours, then rotating the pain away from whoever took the last ones ("Spares Sam, who took the last 3").
stops: Same colleague always gets 3 AM calls
mistakes: meeting at night for remote colleague
